Name: Arcane Focus - Antique Wand
Author: asb3967
Description:
One wand, six elemental spells







Buy the Antique Wand from Pierre's General Store for 3,000g. There is no free starter wand. The farmer looks empty-handed while idle; the wand appears during held focus and the brief casting motion.







Hold right mouse continuously: 0.45 seconds prepares a bolt, 1.25 seconds total prepares an intermediate spell. Release to keep the stage and hold again to continue. Q cycles fire / ice / lightning. Left mouse casts toward the cursor. F stores up to three different spells, V casts the oldest stored spell, and Esc cancels the current preparation. After menus, HUD interaction or loss of window focus, release the focus button fully before starting another hold.







Fire: Firebolt / Fireball



Ice: Icebolt / Ice Spear



Lightning: Lightning Bolt / Thunder







Icebolt provides five separate shots. Ice Spear freezes, bursts after a delay, and can spread when the burst kills. Thunder delivers delayed strikes with a stronger final hit. Mana is spent when casting and regenerates during free gameplay with any tool selected. Stored spells are temporary and clear on the next day or game reload.







Installation



Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2 or later. Extract the ArcaneFocus folder into Mods and launch through SMAPI. All 12 official game languages are included and selected automatically: English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and Simplified Chinese. Price, focus times, mana and key bindings can be changed in config.json.







Limitations



This initial release supports single-player keyboard and mouse. Casting is disabled in multiplayer. Gamepad-only controls and other combat/shop overhaul combinations are unverified. Ice Spear's frozen-target damage reduction applies to this mod's spells, not native weapon hits. See the included English and Korean README files for details.







Inspired by Mabinogi spell identities and Evie's staff focus in Mabinogi Heroes / Vindictus, with original Stardew Valley combat balance. This is an unofficial fan-inspired mod, with no redistributed art from those games.







AI disclosure



AI tools assisted code development and generated the custom wand artwork and this page description. Spell effects and icons are drawn by original mod code. Images on this page are actual game captures from a disposable test save.







한국어 안내



피에르 잡화점에서 골동품 마법봉을 3,000g에 구매합니다. 평소에는 빈손으로 보이고 집중 중·발사할 때만 봉이 나옵니다. 우클릭을 꾹 누르면 0.45초에 볼트, 총 1.25초에 중급 마법이 준비됩니다. 떼면 단계 유지, 다시 누르면 이어서 집중합니다. Q 속성 변경 / 좌클릭 발사 / F 최대 3개 저장 / V 저장 마법 사용 / Esc 현재 준비 취소.







키보드·마우스 싱글 플레이용이며 멀티플레이에서는 시전이 비활성화됩니다. 저장 마법은 다음 날이나 재실행 시 사라집니다. 마나는 도구와 관계없이 자유 행동 중에 회복합니다. 자세한 비용·설정·제한은 동봉 README.ko.txt를 참고하세요.



0.2.0 — Elemental effects and all 12 languages

The casting effects have been rebuilt after reviewing original PC Mabinogi gameplay: connected flame tails and a rolling fire/smoke blast, faceted ice with progressive cracks and shatter, fine branching electricity and separate stronger vertical Thunder strikes. Charge and release share the new elemental artwork. These effects are original C# pixel rendering; no reference video frames or game textures are bundled.



Every official game language has all 32 in-game text entries translated. Long notifications wrap at a readable size. All 12 languages were loaded in the native game and checked for missing glyphs and visible HUD clipping. Translations are AI-assisted; community wording corrections are welcome.



New gallery screenshots are full native 1920x1080 captures from a disposable demonstration save. Targets were arranged and held still for clear effect visibility. The gallery now shows the new 0.2.0 effects; older preview images are hidden.



0.2.0 한국어 안내

공식 지원 12개 언어의 모든 모드 문구를 번역했고 게임 언어에 따라 자동 적용됩니다. 원작 마비노기 시연을 참고해 화염 꼬리·폭연, 다면체 얼음·빙결 균열·파쇄, 가는 연쇄 전기·굵은 낙뢰로 이펙트를 다시 만들었습니다. 긴 알림 문구는 읽기 쉬운 크기로 줄바꿈합니다. 새 사진은 일회용 시연 세이브에서 실제 렌더링한 1920×1080 화면이며, 적의 배치는 촬영을 위해 정리했습니다.
